key.name: temperature-unit
key.description: Unit for temperature display: celsius or fahrenheit (wind follows: km/h or mph)

key.name: panel-display
key.description: What the panel indicator shows: temperature, weather icon, or both

key.name: temperature-position
key.description: Position of temperature relative to icon when both are shown: left or right

key.name: clock-format
key.description: system follows org.gnome.desktop.interface clock-format

key.name: use-colored-temps
key.description: Use blue-to-red gradient for temperature values

key.name: use-colored-uv
key.description: Use color-coded UV index labels

key.name: show-precipitation
key.description: Precipitation probability column and chart

key.name: show-rain-amount
key.description: Precipitation amount (mm or in) column and chart

key.name: show-wind
key.description: Wind speed and direction column, and wind and gust chart

key.name: show-uv-index
key.description: UV index column and chart

key.name: show-humidity
key.description: Relative humidity column, and a humidity chart

key.name: show-feels-like
key.description: Apparent temperature column, and a dashed line in the temperature chart

key.name: show-air-quality
key.description: European AQI and pollen (Europe) from the Open-Meteo air-quality API; one extra request per refresh

key.name: text-scale
key.description: Scales the text, icons and the popup itself

key.name: show-weather-icons
key.description: Display the weather icon in hourly forecast rows

key.name: popup-view
key.description: The forecast view the popup opens with: hourly table, hourly chart or daily; remembers the last one used

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How old the forecast may get before it is fetched again

key.name: favorites
key.description: List of (name, region, ISO-2 country, latitude, longitude)

key.name: active-location
key.description: "auto" for the detected location, or a favourite id "lat,lon" (4 decimals)

key.name: allow-ip-lookup
key.description: When Location Services are off or unavailable, look up the approximate location from the IP address via ipinfo.io

key.name: auto-location-cache
key.description: JSON {location, source, timestamp}; empty triggers re-detection
